handled.text: - Harrow Point is a fishing village of about two hundred people. [migrated-to:: [[Projects/Lighthouse/Ideas/idea-harrow-point|idea-harrow-point]]]
- Mara lives alone in the keeper's cottage at the foot of the tower. [migrated-to:: [[Projects/Lighthouse/Ideas/idea-mara-lighthouse|idea-mara-lighthouse]]]
- Tobias worked summers on the ferry to the mainland. [migrated-to:: [[Projects/Lighthouse/Ideas/idea-tobias|idea-tobias]]]
- He kept a rowing boat tied up under the pier. [migrated-to:: [[Projects/Lighthouse/Ideas/idea-tobias|idea-tobias]]]
- The harbour is too shallow now for anything bigger than a creel boat. #status/provisional [migrated-to:: [[Projects/Lighthouse/Ideas/idea-harrow-point|idea-harrow-point]]]
- Mara repaints the lamp room every spring. #status/committed [migrated-to:: [[Projects/Lighthouse/Areas/area-mara|area-mara]]]
- Harrow Point has a railway halt. #status/rejected
%% No trains. Nothing arrives except by water. %%
- Mara is wary of the mainland doctor. #status/provisional
- Mara is secretly writing a novel. #status/rejected
%% Too writerly. %%
- The fog signal is operated by a clockwork bell. #status/rejected
%% Wrong period for this coast. %%
- The harbour is too shallow now for anything bigger than a creel boat. #status/provisional
- Harrow Point has a lifeboat station. #status/rejected
%% If there's a lifeboat, nobody needs Mara. %%
- The lamp is a fourth-order lens that has never been replaced. #status/provisional
- Mara plays the fiddle in the evenings. #status/rejected
%% She doesn't need a hobby. The silence is the point. %%
- The relief keeper is Tobias's old friend from the ferry. #status/rejected
%% Too tidy. He should be a stranger. %%
%% Everything about Mara's brother. Keep the accident vague for now. %%
- Tobias was four years older than Mara, and she followed him everywhere. #status/provisional
%% Parking this. I don't think I want it, but I don't want to lose it either. %%
- Tobias taught her to read the tide table. #status/rejected
%% Too neat. The tide table is hers alone. %%
%% Agent, idea-harrow-point. %%
%% Agent, idea-mara-lighthouse. %%
%% Agent, both of these go in idea-tobias. %%
%% Agent, area-mara. %%
